Seconds to wait between download retries.
Random delay upper bound (seconds). Empty/random = 0~300s, 0 = no delay.

Number of CFST results to verify against every target domain before ranking.
Concurrent target-domain probes, bounded to protect the proxy-off window.
Per-domain probe timeout; the global hard limit still wins.
